contract.task_clause:
A small kiosk at the Atlanta airport carries souvenirs in the price range of $3.99 to $29.99, with a mean price of $14.75. The airport authorities decide to increase the rent charged for a kiosk by 5 percent. To make up for the increased rent, the kiosk owner decides to increase the prices of all items by 50 cents. As a result, which of the following will happen?
Option A: The mean price and the range of prices will increase by 50 cents.
Option B: The mean price will remain the same, but the range of prices will increase by 50 cents.
Option C: The mean price and the standard deviation of prices will increase by 50 cents.
Option D: The mean price will increase by 50 cents, but the standard deviation of prices will remain the same.
